summary: Layer 1B expands the universe around the AI data-center power and electrical balance-of-plant chokepoint. The evidence supports a shift from chips alone toward transformers, switchgear, electrical construction labor, substations, behind-the-meter power distribution, and data-center/grid co-design. The discovery lane is strongest in specialty electrical contractors and medium-voltage electrical-equipment suppliers where backlog, data-center language, and capacity constraints are visible.
